title.en: Angry Crab Shack sets June 11 opening in Chandler
title.zh: Angry Crab Shack 將於 6 月 11 日在 Chandler 開幕

excerpt.en: Angry Crab Shack will open a Chandler restaurant at 3033 S. Gilbert Road on June 11. The Appiah family will operate the location and launch it with contests, children's activities and nonprofit support.
excerpt.zh: Angry Crab Shack 將於 6 月 11 日在 Chandler 的 3033 S. Gilbert Road 開設餐廳。這家店由 Appiah 家族經營，開幕活動包括比賽、兒童活動和非營利組織支援。

body.en: Angry Crab Shack is opening a new Chandler restaurant on June 11 at 3033 S. Gilbert Road. The location gives the seafood chain another Southeast Valley address for its seafood boils, sauces and casual dining.
body.zh: Angry Crab Shack 將於 6 月 11 日在 Chandler 開設新餐廳，地址是 3033 S. Gilbert Road。這個新據點讓這家海鮮連鎖品牌在東南 Valley 又多了一個供應海鮮鍋、醬料和休閒用餐的地址。

body.en: The Chandler restaurant is owned and operated by the Appiah family, local franchise partners for the brand. The menu will bring the chain's seafood boil format and flavors influenced by Asian and Cajun cooking to the neighborhood.
body.zh: Chandler 餐廳由當地加盟夥伴 Appiah 家族擁有並經營。菜單會把品牌的海鮮鍋形式，以及受亞洲與卡津料理影響的風味帶進這個社區。

body.en: The grand opening will include a spicy wing eating competition with participation from the Chandler Police and Fire Departments. A DJ, a balloon artist for children and a spin to win prize table are also planned, including a chance to win a TV.
body.zh: 開幕活動將安排辣味雞翅大胃王比賽，Chandler 警察局和消防局也會參與。現場還計畫有 DJ、兒童氣球藝術師，以及 spin to win 獎品桌，其中包含贏得電視的機會。

body.en: The event will support local nonprofit organizations, and the restaurant will take part in Angry Crab Shack charitable programs tied to veterans, children's hospitals and local food banks. Angry Crab Shack operates 15 Arizona locations and has more planned for this year.
body.zh: 這場活動將支援當地非營利組織，而餐廳也會參與 Angry Crab Shack 的慈善項目，相關計畫支持退伍軍人、兒童醫院和在地食物銀行。Angry Crab Shack 目前在亞利桑那有 15 個據點，今年還規劃更多門市。

title.en: Black Rock Coffee Bar lines up three Arizona shops
title.zh: Black Rock Coffee Bar 將在亞利桑那新增三家門市

excerpt.en: Black Rock Coffee Bar is preparing new shops in Glendale, Chandler and Prescott Valley. The first is expected in June, with two more planned for July.
excerpt.zh: Black Rock Coffee Bar 準備在 Glendale、Chandler 和 Prescott Valley 開設新門市。第一家預計 6 月開幕，另外兩家規劃在 7 月登場。

body.en: Black Rock Coffee Bar is adding three more Arizona addresses as the coffee chain keeps building its presence in the state. The new shops are planned for Glendale, Chandler and Prescott Valley, giving customers in three different markets another option for coffee, breakfast and quick drinks.
body.zh: Black Rock Coffee Bar 將在亞利桑那再增加三個地址，延續這家咖啡連鎖品牌在州內的展店腳步。新門市分別規劃在 Glendale、Chandler 和 Prescott Valley，讓三個不同市場的顧客多一個買咖啡、早餐和快速飲品的選擇。

body.en: The Glendale location is expected to open first in June at 5937 N. 91st Ave., Suite 130. Two more shops are scheduled to follow in July, one at 3103 S. McQueen Road in Chandler and another at 6272 E. 2nd Street in Prescott Valley.
body.zh: Glendale 門市預計最先在 6 月開幕，地址是 5937 N. 91st Ave., Suite 130。接下來兩家預定在 7 月開出，一家位於 Chandler 的 3103 S. McQueen Road，另一家位於 Prescott Valley 的 6272 E. 2nd Street。

body.en: The company began in Oregon in 2008, when Jeff Hernandez started Black Rock Coffee Bar as a single coffee stand. It has since grown to more than 150 locations across the United States, and the Arizona openings continue that wider expansion.
body.zh: Black Rock Coffee Bar 由 Jeff Hernandez 於 2008 年在俄勒岡創立，最初只是一個咖啡攤。如今品牌在全美已有超過 150 個據點，這批亞利桑那新店是其全國展店的一部分。

body.en: The menu covers hot and iced coffee drinks, cold brew, teas, smoothies, energy beverages and drinks with protein. Food options include breakfast burritos, sandwiches, bagels, muffins and other baked goods.
body.zh: 菜單包括熱咖啡與冰咖啡、冷萃、茶飲、冰沙、能量飲品和含蛋白質的飲品。餐點則有早餐捲餅、三明治、貝果、瑪芬和其他烘焙食品。

title.en: Luna Grill plans three more Phoenix area restaurants in 2026
title.zh: Luna Grill 計畫 2026 年在鳳凰城地區再開三家餐廳

excerpt.en: Luna Grill expects to add restaurants in Tempe, Avondale and north Phoenix before the end of 2026. The additions would follow its first Arizona restaurants in Mesa and Gilbert.
excerpt.zh: Luna Grill 預計在 2026 年底前於 Tempe、Avondale 和北鳳凰城新增餐廳。這些新據點將接續品牌在 Mesa 和 Gilbert 開出的亞利桑那首批門市。

body.en: Luna Grill is preparing at least three more restaurants in the Phoenix area before the end of 2026. The Mediterranean restaurant chain is looking at Tempe, Avondale and north Phoenix for the next stage of its Arizona expansion.
body.zh: Luna Grill 準備在 2026 年底前於鳳凰城地區至少再開三家餐廳。這家地中海料理連鎖品牌下一階段的亞利桑那展店地點包括 Tempe、Avondale 和北鳳凰城。

body.en: The north Phoenix restaurant is planned near the growing area around TSMC's semiconductor campus. A proposed Luna Grill in that part of the city has also been tied to a planned retail project near Dove Valley Road.
body.zh: 北鳳凰城餐廳規劃在 TSMC 半導體園區周邊成長中的區域附近。該市北側先前提出的 Luna Grill 據點，也與 Dove Valley Road 附近一項規劃中的零售開發案有關。

body.en: The new restaurants would follow Luna Grill's entry into Arizona through locations in Mesa and Gilbert. The company started in 2004 with founders Sean and Maria Pourteymour and now operates more than 50 restaurants in California, Texas and Arizona.
body.zh: 這些新餐廳將接續 Luna Grill 在 Mesa 和 Gilbert 開出的亞利桑那首批據點。Luna Grill 由 Sean 和 Maria Pourteymour 於 2004 年創立，目前在加州、德州和亞利桑那經營超過 50 家餐廳。

body.en: Luna Grill's menu includes kabobs, bowls, salads, pitas, family meals and other Mediterranean dishes made with fresh ingredients and cooked to order. Exact opening dates for the Tempe, Avondale and north Phoenix restaurants have not been announced.
body.zh: Luna Grill 的菜單有烤肉串、碗餐、沙拉、皮塔餅、家庭餐和其他以新鮮食材現做的地中海料理。Tempe、Avondale 和北鳳凰城餐廳的確切開幕日期尚未公布。

title.en: Atashi Yokocho planned for Scottsdale's The Sydney
title.zh: Atashi Yokocho 規劃進駐 Scottsdale 的 The Sydney

excerpt.en: Restaurateur Huy Truong is planning a Japanese dining hall at The Sydney in Scottsdale. Atashi Yokocho is expected in 2028 with about 15 separate restaurant concepts.
excerpt.zh: 餐飲業者 Huy Truong 正計畫在 Scottsdale 的 The Sydney 打造日本餐飲空間。Atashi Yokocho 預計 2028 年開幕，內部約有 15 個不同餐飲概念。

body.en: Atashi Yokocho is planned for The Sydney at 7339 E. McDonald Drive in Scottsdale. Restaurateur Huy Truong is preparing the project for a 2028 opening at the large development near Loop 101 and Pima Road.
body.zh: Atashi Yokocho 規劃落腳於 Scottsdale 的 The Sydney，地址是 7339 E. McDonald Drive。餐飲業者 Huy Truong 正籌備這個項目，預計 2028 年在 Loop 101 和 Pima Road 附近的大型開發案中開幕。

body.en: The project takes its cue from Japan's yokocho dining culture, where narrow lanes are filled with small restaurants and bars. In Scottsdale, the format is expected to bring about 15 individual eateries into one shared destination.
body.zh: 這個項目以日本橫丁飲食文化為靈感，日本橫丁通常是狹窄巷弄中聚集小餐館和酒吧的空間。到了 Scottsdale，這個形式預計會把約 15 個獨立餐飲概念放在同一個目的地內。

body.en: The food lineup is planned to cover several types of Japanese cuisine. Ramen, sushi, tempura, yakitori, yakiniku, kaiseki and regional specialties are among the categories being considered for the space.
body.zh: 規劃中的餐飲內容涵蓋多種日本料理。拉麵、壽司、天婦羅、串燒、燒肉、懷石料理和地方特色料理，都是目前考慮納入的類別。

body.en: Restaurant spaces inside Atashi Yokocho could vary widely in size, with some seating as few as eight guests and others seating up to 50. Truong is also looking at rotating short run concepts that would let Japanese operators test their brands with Arizona diners.
body.zh: Atashi Yokocho 內部的餐廳空間大小可能差異很大，有些只能容納 8 位客人，有些可坐到 50 人。Truong 也在研究輪替式短期餐飲概念，讓日本業者有機會向亞利桑那食客介紹品牌。

body.en: Truong has already brought several Japanese restaurant brands to the Valley, including multiple Mensho Ramen locations and Udon Shin in Mesa. Atashi Yokocho is set to join other restaurant and entertainment tenants planned for The Sydney.
body.zh: Truong 已經把多個日本餐飲品牌帶進 Valley，包括數家 Mensho Ramen 門市，以及位於 Mesa 的 Udon Shin。Atashi Yokocho 將加入 The Sydney 規劃中的其他餐飲與娛樂租戶。

title.en: Grandioso targets mid July debut on Phoenix's Grand Avenue
title.zh: Grandioso 目標 7 月中旬在鳳凰城 Grand Avenue 開幕

excerpt.en: Justin Piazza is preparing Grandioso at 1227 Grand Ave with pizza, drinks and a bar style setup. The opening could come July 15, later than the July 1 target.
excerpt.zh: Justin Piazza 正在 1227 Grand Ave 籌備 Grandioso，主打披薩、飲品和酒吧式空間。開幕時間可能落在 7 月 15 日，晚於原先 7 月 1 日的目標。

body.en: Grandioso is planned for 1227 Grand Ave in Phoenix, where restaurateur and pizzaiolo Justin Piazza is preparing a summer opening. The team has aimed for July 1, but Piazza has said July 15 is now the more likely date.
body.zh: Grandioso 規劃開在鳳凰城 1227 Grand Ave，餐飲業者與披薩師 Justin Piazza 正準備夏季開幕。團隊原本瞄準 7 月 1 日，但 Piazza 表示目前 7 月 15 日更有可能。

body.en: The concept will focus on pizza and drinks with the feel of a neighborhood dive bar. Piazza is shaping the restaurant as a place for a slice, a drink and time spent hanging out on the Grand Avenue corridor.
body.zh: 這個概念會以披薩和飲品為主，空間氛圍接近社區型 dive bar。Piazza 正把餐廳打造為一個能吃一片披薩、喝一杯飲料，並在 Grand Avenue 走廊停留聊天的地方。

body.en: Pizza will be the center of the menu, with four styles planned. Grandioso will serve New York style pizza, Roman taglio style squares, Detroit style pan pizza and tavern style pies with a thin, crisp crust.
body.zh: 披薩會是菜單核心，目前規劃四種風格。Grandioso 將供應 New York style 披薩、Roman taglio style 方形披薩、Detroit style 烤盤披薩，以及薄脆餅皮的 tavern style 披薩。

body.en: The restaurant is also expected to have a full bar, baked wings, appetizers and panino sandwiches. Service will follow a quick service and bar model rather than traditional table service.
body.zh: 餐廳也預計提供完整酒吧、烤雞翅、開胃菜和 panino 三明治。營運模式會偏向快速點餐與酒吧服務，而不是傳統桌邊服務。

body.en: Piazza is known for La Piazza Al Forno and past downtown Phoenix restaurant projects. Grandioso will also lean into the area's arts identity, with murals planned inside and outside, plus a pool table and jukebox in the space.
body.zh: Piazza 以 La Piazza Al Forno 及過去在鳳凰城市中心的餐飲項目為人所知。Grandioso 也會呼應該區的藝術特色，室內外都規劃壁畫，空間內還會有撞球桌和點唱機。
